03_problem.png.title: Problem
03_problem.png.subtitle: Agents decide fast — value movement must not
bullets: An Almanak decide() can propose a swap the moment prices dip.
Without a gate, keepers can broadcast oversized or off-policy clips.
Need fail-closed policy: max notional, HITL, daily cap, confidence, venues.
Missing confidence, unknown chain, or oversize notional must block.

04_architecture.png.title: Architecture
04_architecture.png.subtitle: Almanak intent → Cubiczan CHP → KeeperHub
bullets: 1) Almanak decide() returns Intent.swap with notional + confidence.
2) Adapter remaps chain base → Base Sepolia (84532) for testnet.
3) CHP trail: EXPLORING → PROVISIONAL → LOCKED | HITL | BLOCKED.
4) Only LOCKED may simulate then execute on KeeperHub (MOCK here).
5) Dual audit: CHP HMAC ledger + KeeperHub execution id.
